# AOL
> AOL is a news, entertainment, lifestyle, finance, and email portal featuring curated headlines, original service pages, and consumer products.

AOL combines breaking news coverage with topic hubs for entertainment, finance, shopping, travel, and lifestyle, while also providing access to AOL Mail and subscription-based security and support products.

## Main Portal
- [AOL Homepage](https://www.aol.com/): Main portal for headlines, entertainment, lifestyle, finance, and access to AOL services.
- [News](https://www.aol.com/news/): Aggregated breaking news, politics, weather, and major current events coverage.
- [Entertainment](https://www.aol.com/entertainment/): Celebrity news, TV, movies, music, and pop culture coverage.
- [Finance](https://www.aol.com/finance/): Business news, markets coverage, and personal finance headlines.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/): Lifestyle features spanning health, home, relationships, and everyday living.
- [Shopping](https://www.aol.com/shopping/): Product picks, retail deals, gift ideas, and commerce-focused articles.

## News Topics
- [Politics](https://www.aol.com/news/politics/): Political news, elections, government developments, and policy coverage.
- [World News](https://www.aol.com/news/world/): International breaking news and major global developments.
- [U.S. News](https://www.aol.com/news/): National headlines and top domestic news stories.
- [Weather](https://www.aol.com/weather/): Weather forecasts, severe weather updates, and climate-related headlines.
- [Crime](https://www.aol.com/news/crime/): Crime reporting, investigations, and public safety stories.
- [Good News](https://www.aol.com/news/good-news/): Positive and uplifting human-interest news stories.

## Entertainment & Culture
- [Celebrity](https://www.aol.com/entertainment/celebrities/): Celebrity updates, interviews, relationships, and red carpet coverage.
- [TV](https://www.aol.com/entertainment/tv/): Television news, streaming updates, recaps, and casting stories.
- [Movies](https://www.aol.com/entertainment/movies/): Film news, trailers, releases, and movie industry coverage.
- [Music](https://www.aol.com/entertainment/music/): Music news, artist updates, releases, and industry stories.
- [Awards](https://www.aol.com/entertainment/awards/): Coverage of major award shows, nominees, and winners.

## Finance & Business
- [Finance Home](https://www.aol.com/finance/): Central hub for market, business, and money coverage.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.aol.com/finance/personal-finance/): Saving, spending, retirement, and consumer money advice.
- [Markets](https://www.aol.com/finance/markets/): Stock market news, indexes, and investing-related updates.
- [Economy](https://www.aol.com/finance/economy/): Economic indicators, inflation, jobs, and macroeconomic reporting.
- [Real Estate](https://www.aol.com/finance/real-estate/): Housing market trends, home prices, and property news.

## Lifestyle
- [Lifestyle Home](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/): Broad lifestyle coverage across wellness, family, and home topics.
- [Health](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/health/): Health news, wellness trends, and medical interest stories.
- [Style](https://www.aol.com/style/): Fashion, beauty, celebrity style, and trend coverage.
- [Food](https://www.aol.com/food/): Recipes, cooking inspiration, food news, and entertaining ideas.
- [Travel](https://www.aol.com/travel/): Destination ideas, travel tips, and vacation-related features.
- [Home](https://www.aol.com/lifestyle/home/): Home improvement, decor, cleaning, and organization content.

## Shopping & Deals
- [Shopping Home](https://www.aol.com/shopping/): Shopping coverage featuring product roundups, recommendations, and seasonal deals.
- [Deals](https://www.aol.com/shopping/deals/): Discount-focused shopping stories and limited-time offers.
- [Gift Guides](https://www.aol.com/shopping/gift-guides/): Curated gift recommendations for holidays and special occasions.
- [Style Shopping](https://www.aol.com/shopping/style/): Fashion and beauty shopping recommendations.
- [Home Shopping](https://www.aol.com/shopping/home/): Home goods, kitchen, and household product picks.
- [Tech Shopping](https://www.aol.com/shopping/tech/): Consumer electronics recommendations and gadget deals.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.aol.com/sports/): Sports headlines, scores, analysis, and major league coverage.
- [NFL](https://www.aol.com/sports/nfl/): National Football League news, games, and player updates.
- [NBA](https://www.aol.com/sports/nba/): Basketball news, trades, standings, and game coverage.
- [MLB](https://www.aol.com/sports/mlb/): Baseball headlines, scores, and season developments.
- [NHL](https://www.aol.com/sports/nhl/): Hockey news, results, and league updates.
- [College Sports](https://www.aol.com/sports/college/): College football and basketball news and analysis.

## AOL Services
- [AOL Mail](https://mail.aol.com/): Webmail service for accessing AOL email accounts and inbox tools.
- [Login](https://login.aol.com/): Account sign-in page for AOL Mail and related AOL services.
- [Products](https://www.aol.com/products/): Overview of AOL subscription products for security, support, and device protection.
- [AOL App](https://www.aol.com/products/aol-app): Mobile app information for accessing AOL news, mail, and content.
- [AOL Plans](https://www.aol.com/products/plans): Subscription plans for AOL services and bundled offerings.

## Security & Support Products
- [AOL Shield Pro](https://www.aol.com/products/shieldpro): Security product for browsing protection, antivirus, and privacy features.
- [AOL Desktop Gold](https://www.aol.com/products/desktop-gold): Premium desktop software combining mail, browsing, and security tools.
- [AOL Tech Fortress](https://www.aol.com/products/tech-fortress): Device security and support bundle for protecting connected devices.
- [AOL Computer Checkup](https://www.aol.com/products/computer-checkup): PC optimization and maintenance product for performance improvements.
- [AOL 24x7 Live Support](https://www.aol.com/products/live-support): On-demand technical support service for AOL customers.
- [AOL Identity Protection](https://www.aol.com/products/identity-protection): Identity monitoring and protection service for personal information security.

## Help & Account
- [Help](https://help.aol.com/): Support center for AOL Mail, account access, billing, and product help.
- [Mail Help](https://help.aol.com/products/aol-mail): Help articles for AOL Mail setup, troubleshooting, and account management.
- [Account Management Help](https://help.aol.com/products/account): Support for passwords, sign-in issues, and account settings.
- [Desktop Gold Help](https://help.aol.com/products/desktop-gold): Troubleshooting and setup documentation for AOL Desktop Gold.
- [Contact Us](https://help.aol.com/contact/): Customer support contact options for AOL products and services.
